title: Combined Work Rate of Sheela and Meena
subject: Mathematics
caption: Work‑rate diagram for Sheela and Meena showing individual rates (½ and ⅔ suit per day), their combined rate (7⁄6 suits per day), and the calculation that 30 suits require 35 days.
altText: A Cartesian diagram with a white background. The horizontal axis (Days) runs from 0 to 40, and the vertical axis (Suits) runs from 0 to 8. Three lines start at the origin: a blue line representing Sheela’s rate of one‑half suit per day, a green line for Meena’s rate of two‑thirds suit per day, and a red line for their combined rate of seven‑sixths suit per day. Each line is labeled near its top end. Below the axes, a text note states: “30 suits ÷ (7⁄6 suits per day) = 35 days.”
